readerCopy.headline: Your feelings are taking up more room.
readerCopy.body:
You may want to feed everyone, stay longer, spend more on home, or say yes to someone close before checking the rest of the day. Home can feel fuller. Affection can feel easier to give. A family plan may become more important because the emotional meaning behind it is harder to ignore.

Jupiter conjunct Moon can make warmth abundant and limits easy to forget. Let the feeling be real without turning every feeling into a commitment. You can be generous and still check what the promise requires from tomorrow morning, the budget, or the rest of the week.
